addressed.claim_id: Vendor normalization: replaced single conditional pop with loop that repeatedly drops trailing legal-form suffix tokens (fixes ACME LTD INC -> ACME, FOO SA LTD -> FOO, and LTD INC -> empty).
Amount scale check: replaced numeric quantize-equality test with Decimal exponent/scale check (exponent >= -2) so 10.000 and 10.120 are rejected while 50.0 and signed amounts are allowed.

Decimal InvalidOperation leaks: removed quantize from validation path and added localcontext with sufficient precision plus try/except for output quantization so large finite 2dp amounts succeed and any remaining decimal errors become ValueError.
